cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Private collection, San Antonio, Texas, 1959; Estate of private collector, 1963 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature. On backing: in pencil, by O'Keeffe: "Sun Water Maine" 1922" [not verified]. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates "star." Inscription 2 dates 1922 and indicates no. 10 in 1923 New York (Anderson). Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert, Feb, 1959." Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 13. See cat. nos. 381–86. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Sun Water Maine

description: Undulating blue hills stretch across the work's foreground. Beyond these, a body of light blue water meets a white and yellow sky with a glowing yellow sun. Haloes of light encircle the sun.
